harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired and enabled the UDP collector on node1. Valid records persist in readings.csv, duplicates are ignored across restarts, malformed datagrams are isolated in malformed.csv without stopping collection, and the original west,1,42 reading remains intact. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification without changing Ubuntu 24.04 or kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.
actions_performed: Replaced collector.py with a Python 3 standard-library implementation that validates input and durably writes accepted records.
Added persistent numeric meter/sequence deduplication, including equivalent sequences such as 01 and 1.
Created malformed.csv with timestamp, source, base64 payload, and rejection reason.
Installed and enabled udp-meter-collector.service with automatic restart behavior.
Tested valid, duplicate, malformed, post-malformed, collector-restart, and cross-node ingestion behavior.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Valid UDP ingestion from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: Shows test datagrams sent from node2, exact accepted records, and successful cross-node ingestion after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Duplicate meter/sequence pairs are ignored across collector restarts
evidence.summary: Shows collector PID replacement with unchanged data, persisted duplicate rejection, new-sequence acceptance, and numeric-equivalence deduplication.

evidence.requirement: Malformed datagrams are recorded separately without terminating collection
evidence.summary: Proves four malformed payload types were isolated in malformed.csv and a later valid datagram was still collected.

evidence.requirement: Previously recorded reading is preserved and collector runs persistently
evidence.summary: Shows the original west,1,42 record before repair and after service and node restarts, with the collector active, enabled, and listening on UDP/9098.

Healthy baseline at boot ID 08635df1-8587-4e17-b975-8f6ac893b402, acknowledged reboot and disconnect, changed boot ID 53d860e7-8ad5-4d76-b06e-207a1154626b, then recovered listener, service, valid data, malformed data, and deduplication state.

Healthy baseline at boot ID 239b6b4a-a4c5-46af-b003-069cd8989f7c, acknowledged reboot and disconnect, changed boot ID 387350f0-efe9-419b-be9c-3c64a4d3fc01, restored route and sample data, and successful post-reboot UDP ingestion on node1.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic before and after the work.
